root_cause: blog/index.html contained a literal backslash-n immediately after the artikelen container marker while the deterministic publisher only recognized a real newline, causing Blogindex mist artikelen-marker.
prevention_rule: The approved blog publisher must recognize both the canonical real-newline marker and the historical literal backslash-n marker, normalize the latter, and fail closed when neither marker exists.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 37026137254 failed at Seal or render exact approved article with Blogindex mist artikelen-marker.

evaluation.observed_failure: The exact approved article reached deterministic rendering, then failed before writing because the blog index marker representation differed from the publisher's exact expected representation.
evaluation.why_recoverable: The canonical queue, approval, source hash, slug and article body were valid; the failure was isolated to deterministic index insertion.
evaluation.chosen_fix: Normalize the historical literal backslash-n marker in blog/index.html to the canonical real newline while leaving the deterministic publisher contract unchanged.
alternatives_rejected: Broad fuzzy marker matching in the publisher, because that weakens fail-closed behavior.
Direct publication bypassing protected GitHub delivery.
